model_manifest.model_rule: predict heldout CVSS v3.x base score from training-only medians over CWE, CPE-count bin, reference-count bin, and visible description/reference/source tokens; baseScore, severity, CVSS vector metrics, exploitabilityScore, and impactScore remain hidden until scoring

comparator_baseline.prediction_rule: predict heldout CVSS score from the training-only median score for the same CWE, otherwise the global training median
